small_guidance:
- The autotune config grid is too large (21 configs) and combined with `.item()` synchronizations on every forward call, autotune likely caused subprocess timeout. Cut to 4-6 configs (e.g. BLOCK_SP=16/32/64 × num_warps=4/8, num_stages=2/3) and pass scale1/scale2 as tensors or cache the .item() in __init__ if possible.
- Reduce static unrolling: the nested `static_range` over KD×2×KH×2×KW×2×IC = 3·2·3·2·3·2·3 = 648 iterations of fully unrolled body produces huge IR and slow compile per-config — collapse the inner `dd/hh/ww` 2× loops into runtime loops or fold the avg-pool window differently.
- Add `key=['N','OC','POD','POH','POW']` only on small set; ensure first call uses a warmup so the autotune doesn't dominate the timing window.
large_guidance:
- Restructure as a two-kernel pipeline: (1) a scatter-add ConvTranspose3d writing to a full (N,OC,OD,OH,OW) buffer with fused conv_bias+scale1, then (2) a small fused avg_pool3d+bias+scale2 kernel. The current gather-style fused kernel has an enormous unrolled iteration space (KD·KH·KW·8·IC ≈ 648) which blows up compile time and likely caused the 600s subprocess timeout.
- Alternatively, implement the transposed conv as an im2col-style GEMM: program tile over (N, OC_tile, output-spatial tile of the pooled grid, 2³=8 sub-positions); use tl.dot over an IC*KD*KH*KW reduction with BLOCK_K=32-64. This gives real tensor-core utilization vs. the current scalar FMA accumulation.
- Use channels-last (NDHWC) layout for both input and weight so the IC reduction axis is contiguous and loads coalesce; precompute valid-input index tables on host if needed to avoid divmod in the kernel.
